ranking_basis: Expected spatially blocked HOLDOUT-DTI improvement per implementation cost. Not a projected leaderboard score. Owner-reported 0.2778 / 0.3195 / 0.4413 are not organizer receipts.

hypotheses.name: Visible-fault explained-edge residual
hypotheses.physical_signature: Gaussian expected-edge profile of visible faults subtracted from magnetic and gravity horizontal-gradient magnitudes, then structure-tensor coherence of the residual.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: A withheld or unmapped strand keeps its geophysical edge after the visible-fault expected edge is removed. Painting the raw edge wastes dots on the mapped trace the metric penalises.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Prior lanes collar the catalogue and rank raw edges, tips, or phase congruency. None fits and subtracts a frozen visible-fault expected-edge profile before corroborating magnetic and gravity residuals.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Lithologic contact or flight-line residual that is linear and off the mapped catalogue.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Highest of this queue: the holdout truth is withheld catalogue segments, which are exactly unexplained edges.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium. Native bands only. No new external file.
hypotheses.falsifier: Paired HOLDOUT-DTI versus the raw-edge control has a 95% CI that includes or falls below zero.

hypotheses.name: Basement-interface gravity mass-balance residual
hypotheses.physical_signature: Training-only linear slab response of smoothed basement depth removed from isostatic gravity; coherent residual gradient.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: A buried basement step can sit under basin fill with no mapped scarp. The smooth basement surface absorbs the broad basin; a short residual step would not.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Previously proposed and not executed as its own candidate. H86E-SPBT pairs the two bands as steps; H86H-PSTD uses tensors; H86K-PSC uses Hessian saddles. This arm is the frozen forward residual.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Lateral sediment-density change, basement-surface smoothing error, or model-edge ringing.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Lower than VFGR on this holdout, because withheld truth is surface-mapped and may already be inside the basement surface.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium. Native bands only. Band 15 is gravity-derived, so circularity is tested by the raw-gravity comparison inside the same fit family only through the paired arm, not assumed away.
hypotheses.falsifier: Residual coherent gradient does not beat a basement-gradient-only reading, or training R² shows the residual is numerical noise.

hypotheses.name: Gravity step-versus-compact-source shape test
hypotheses.physical_signature: Width and signed east/south derivative pattern compared with a frozen extended-step template versus a compact-source template.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: An extended buried step can be coherent across strike without being the single strongest gradient pixel already ranked by prior lanes.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: No explicit competing-source likelihood exists in scripts/ or src/. Band 11 is a signed southward derivative, not vertical gravity.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Elongated intrusive contact or overlapping compact sources.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium-high. Not started. Would consume the third experiment if VFGR were not selected.
hypotheses.falsifier: Step likelihood does not beat the compact-source control on paired HOLDOUT-DTI.

hypotheses.name: Conductivity-neck topology under dilatation
hypotheses.physical_signature: Narrow conductive-component necks that persist across a frozen threshold range and co-locate with positive dilatation.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: A concealed permeability neck can connect conductive patches without a scarp. Band 17 is surface conductance, not a depth-resolved MT image.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Listed as an unrun reserve. Existing lanes use conductivity gradients or halos, not threshold-persistent necks.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Saline playa, clay paleochannel, or interpolation bottleneck.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Lowest of the native-band set. Conductivity is nonspecific.
hypotheses.falsifier: Neck features fail to beat conductivity-only and strain-only controls.

hypotheses.name: Flight-line-orthogonal magnetic residual
hypotheses.physical_signature: Residual after removing the along-line median, so faults parallel to GeoDAWN flight lines are not suppressed by decorrugation.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Decorrugation can erase flight-parallel contacts that never received a mapped scarp.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: No flight-line azimuth grid is used by an executed GEMSDOE86 lane.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Residual levelling error along the flight direction.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Unknown until the line azimuth is in hand. Not ranked above executable native-band tests.
hypotheses.official_source_note: USGS GeoDAWN DOI 10.5066/P93LGLVQ is the official flight-line release. This checkout has no flight-line azimuth raster, and the sandbox cannot fetch USGS hosts. Not proposed as viable until that grid is hash-pinned.
hypotheses.falsifier: Along-line residual does not beat raw RTP horizontal gradient on paired HOLDOUT-DTI.

execution.reason: Paired HOLDOUT-DTI versus the raw-edge control was entirely below zero, and final dots informatively overlapped GEMSDOE46.
